text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

change.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else exactly the same.
